sections.html: There are many enigmatic species of piranha, but one of the most mysterious is S. neveriensis. For the first time, two specimens could be imported from Venezuela, which match the anatomical features of this species, described in 1993, very well. The coloration of the fish varies a lot. In a picture taken in the field by the supplier, one specimen has a black marginal seam in the caudal fin, which is thought to be species-specific for S. neveriensis, but which is not observable (yet?) in these two fish. In any case, the two are very interesting specimens, real highlights for piranha fans.
